supports.quote: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year.

supports.quote: it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one. nothing fancy.

framings.text: Possible outcome: one place showing each book and a short note about what you thought of it, without unnecessary complexity.
